title: One Person, One Verb: Purpose with the Infinitive
goal: State a purpose with para, a fin de and con el objeto de + infinitive when one person acts.
grammar: Purpose with one subject: the infinitive

items: I can state a purpose with para, a fin de and con el objeto de + infinitive when one person acts.
I can choose between the infinitive and que + subjunctive by looking at the subjects.
I can use the new words for plans and efforts.
